# Project Helios Overview

Project Helios is a renewable energy initiative led by Acme Energy. The program
aims to deploy solar microgrids across rural regions.

## Market Opportunity

The global microgrid market reached 28 billion in 2024 and is projected to grow
at 12% annually. Acme Energy estimates a serviceable market of 4 million
households.

## Technology

The Helios Platform combines solar panels with battery storage. Each microgrid
serves up to 500 households and reduces diesel usage by 70%.

- Solar generation with smart inverters
- Lithium battery storage rated at 200 kWh
- Remote monitoring via the Helios Cloud

## Impact

In the first pilot, Project Helios connected 12000 users and cut carbon
emissions by 35%. Customer satisfaction reached 92%.
